dct_title_s: Ocean Features - Points (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This point layer contains ocean features such as reefs, rocks, lighthouses, beacons and harbors for the waters off China.

Purpose: This data is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, hydrographical analysis, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis as needed. These data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on navigable waterways, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
